source_identity.title: Minoan linguistic resources: The Linear A Digital Corpus

reported_corpus_architecture.source_transcription_base: John G. Younger digital phonetic transcriptions
conversion_chain: automatic conversion to GORILA sign identifiers
manual checking of the GORILA conversion against GORILA volumes
automatic conversion from GORILA identifiers to Linear A Unicode
manual correction/completion of XML against GORILA volumes
reported_corpus_architecture.2015_completion_note: The authors reported XML conversion as automated while manual tagging/checking against GORILA was still in progress.

provenance_classification.reason: The corpus derives transcription content from Younger and explicitly checks transformations/annotation against GORILA. It is valuable as an independently engineered Unicode/TEI digitization and editorial representation, not as independent transcription evidence.

continuation_evidence.linked_project: Giving Voice to the Minoan People: The Decipherment of Linear A
continuation_evidence.2019_activity_title: The Linear A Digital Corpus: Digital Humanities and Language Decipherment
continuation_evidence.interpretation: Evidence that the research line continued beyond the 2015 publication; it does not establish survival or public availability of the original XML bytes.

relationship_to_existing_JANUS_sources.mwenge_LinearA_Explorer: NOT_THE_SAME_SOURCE; mwenge is separately derived from GORILA/Douros and is already canonical JANUS source lineage.

admission_if_bytes_recovered.first_action: Preserve original/archive-replayed bytes before opening, conversion, normalization or content-driven selection.
required_before_adapter: SHA-256 and byte length for every recovered XML or original archive
proof of relationship to the 2015 corpus rather than a later independently reconstructed corpus

potential_JANUS_lane.purpose: Test source-format/digitization robustness and harden a TEI-EpiDoc source adapter without treating the corpus as independent transcription replication.
